subject: Action required: multiple declines on Acme Corp subscriptions / card update workflow
messages:
From: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@acmecorp.com>
To: olga.petrov@redwood.ai, payments@acmecorp.com
Date: Fri, 28 May 2027 09:12:00 -0400
Subject: Urgent: Subscriptions suspended due to card declines (Invoice ACME-202705-01)

Hi Olga / Redwood billing team,

We received an automated notice that two of our active subscriptions were suspended this morning after a sequence of card declines. The invoices reference ACME-202705-01 and ACME-202705-02. Our finance team tried a retry and saw the same declines (card ending 4242 and 6789). Stripe logs show: card_declined / insufficient_funds / authentication_required (3DS).

We have a renewed PO ready to cover the amount but need a short window of access while the card is updated — can you advise the fastest path to restore service? We also attached the invoice output from our side.

Thanks,
Liam O'Connor
Head of Finance, Acme Corp
liam.oconnor@acmecorp.com
+44 20 7946 0XXX

Attachments: invoice_ACME-202705-01.pdf
From: olga.petrov@redwood.ai
To: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@acmecorp.com>
Cc: ben.carter@redwood.ai, rachel.kim@redwood.ai
Date: Fri, 28 May 2027 10:03:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Urgent: Subscriptions suspended due to card declines (Invoice ACME-202705-01)

Hi Liam — thanks for flagging this and for the PO. Short answers up front: we can (A) provide a secure card-update link for immediate retry, (B) schedule a manual retry from billing ops after you update the card or provide a replacement payment method, or (C) provision a one-off credit while you finalize payment (requires approvals).

Next steps I recommend:
- Please use the secure update link below to add a new card (we support 3DS flows).
- If you prefer we can accept a wire/ACH against the PO and then unblock access the same business day once funds clear — I will confirm the treasury details if you choose that route.

Proposed timeline:
- Today: you send updated card or wire confirmation.
- Within 30–90 minutes after successful authorization: we lift the suspend and resume the subscriptions.

Secure card update link: https://pay.redwood.ai/update/ACME-D-83921 (expires in 72 hours)
Stripe reference: https://dashboard.stripe.com/payments/pm_1JX2...

I've looped in Ben from Billing (ben.carter) to coordinate the manual retry and check credit hold.

—Olga
Olga Petrov | Account Lead, Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference
olga.petrov@redwood.ai | +1 415 555 02XX
From: ben.carter@redwood.ai
To: olga.petrov@redwood.ai, Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@acmecorp.com>
Cc: rachel.kim@redwood.ai
Date: Fri, 28 May 2027 11:22:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Urgent: Subscriptions suspended due to card declines (Invoice ACME-202705-01)

Quick update from ops: I pulled the decline logs — two attempts were declined with insufficient_funds, a third attempt returned authentication_required. Logs attached (stripe-decline-log-ACME-20270528.csv).

If Liam updates the card via Olga's link and the authorization succeeds, I can trigger a manual retry and waive the late fees for this cycle. If you'd rather wire, CC Redwood-billing@redwood.ai with the remittance and I'll mark the invoice paid and request immediate restore.

Also noting: Acme has two subscriptions tied to different billing profiles. If you update the card on the account root, both should retry automatically; otherwise we can add a payment method per-subscription.

Ben Carter
Billing Operations Manager
Redwood Inference
From: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@acmecorp.com>
To: ben.carter@redwood.ai, olga.petrov@redwood.ai
Date: Sat, 29 May 2027 08:07:00 +0100
Subject: Re: Urgent: Subscriptions suspended due to card declines (Invoice ACME-202705-01)

Thanks Ben / Olga — we've updated the card via the link (card ending 1114), completed 3DS auth successfully. I've attached the signed PO and confirmation from our treasury that the new card is authorized for recurring charges. Can you confirm when the subscriptions will come back online?

Attached: invoice_ACME-202705-01.pdf, acme_po_4498_signed.pdf

—Liam
From: ben.carter@redwood.ai
To: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@acmecorp.com>
Cc: olga.petrov@redwood.ai, rachel.kim@redwood.ai, marissa.cole@redwood.ai
Date: Sun, 30 May 2027 16:35:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Urgent: Subscriptions suspended due to card declines (Invoice ACME-202705-01)

Liam — verified the new payment method and successful authorization (Stripe auth: 3ds_authenticated). I triggered a manual retry across both billing profiles; payments settled and we reactivated the subscriptions at 16:21 ET. I also applied a one-time courtesy credit for the downtime and removed the late fee per Olga's approval.

Summary / next steps:
- Status: Active (both subscriptions restored).
- Amounts settled: $23,450.00 (combined) — receipt links have been emailed to your payments address.
- If you want to add a secondary backup payment method to avoid repeat interruptions, we recommend adding a backup card or enabling ACH with automated retries.

Thanks for the quick turnaround — reach out if anything else pops up.

Ben Carter
Billing Operations Manager | Redwood Inference
Attachments: stripe-decline-log-ACME-20270528.csv
